hero.title: {name}: bring AI into every business process
hero.introFirst: Feiyu AI is built for teams creating knowledge-augmented and agent-driven applications, bringing model access, knowledge engineering, agents, skills and MCP tools into one enterprise platform. It offers app configuration UIs plus a complete pipeline from data preparation and capability orchestration to streaming chat and platform governance.
hero.introSecond: The core value is consolidating scattered AI capabilities into manageable, composable and deliverable business modules, keeping teams technically autonomous while avoiding the cost of rebuilding model gateways, RAG pipelines, tool invocation and permission systems.

architecture.title: System Component Architecture
architecture.description: Module relationships from frontend interaction and service aggregation to core AI capabilities and infrastructure
architecture.diagramDesc: Users access the Feiyu AI platform server through the Feiyu AI console. The server aggregates permissions, AIGC, AI runtime and common services, connecting to relational databases, vector databases, S3 object storage, model providers and MCP services.
architecture.userAdminDesc: Configure, build and use AI apps
architecture.ui: Unified management and app interaction UI
architecture.server: Service aggregation, API publishing and runtime config
architecture.commonServicesDesc: OSS, jobs, authentication and base utilities
architecture.diagramNote: Module boundaries follow the current system layout; data and external services can scale independently in deployment.

license.title: Licensing & Compliance
license.description: Feiyu AI is built on its own core capabilities together with multiple open-source components. License notices for those components are provided with the deployment package; see the third-party license notice file in the deployment directory.
